Raise a floor by editing this file on purpose, in the same change that adds the checks, from a green run. Never lower one to get green. Nothing writes this file.

expected_red_max is the most expected red a gate may print. tools/floors.js fails a gate above its ceiling, and fails a gate that prints an expected red count with no ceiling here, so a failing check cannot be let off as expected red unseen. Added empty on 9 October: the lead sets each value from a clean full run, as printed, and until then the engine's floor step fails by name. It drops to 0 in the change that turns the expected reds green.
